interface.title: Neuroglancer
interface.stage_of_work: Exploring reconstructed volumes: looking at raw EM next to an existing segmentation and its meshes, then marking points of interest
interface.what_it_is_for: A WebGL viewer in the browser that streams very large EM image volumes, segmentation volumes and neuron meshes over HTTP and shows them together in linked cross-section and 3-D views.

data.note: The URL fragment loaded the FlyEM FIB-25 public example: precomputed://gs://neuroglancer-public-data/flyem_fib-25/image (uint8 EM, 8 nm isotropic, 6446×6643×8090 voxels) and .../ground_truth (uint64 segmentation with single-resolution meshes), with 5 neurons preselected. Chunks and meshes streamed live from GCS. It took a few seconds to load; the first screenshot (screens/001.webp) was blank.

tree.general: Understand the 3-D shape and surroundings of individual cells in a large volumetric image by viewing raw signal, labels and surface models together
tree.specific: Inspect FIB-25 fly-brain neurons by browsing the EM volume, the ground-truth segmentation and the neuron meshes in Neuroglancer's 4-pane view

features.name: Linked multi-planar + 3-D viewer with a shared cursor
features.general: Show three orthogonal slices and a 3-D view that share one position; move in any one and the others follow; maximise one panel and restore it
features.specific: 4panel layout (XY, XZ, YZ and 3-D) with a shared red/green/blue crosshair: wheel steps sections, control+wheel zooms, drag pans or rotates, ◻ maximises a panel, the restore button and JSON 'layout' switch arrangements
steps: scroll or press ./, to change section
control+wheel to zoom
drag to pan (2-D) or rotate (3-D)
press ◻ to maximise a panel
press restore to return to the 4-panel layout
serves_tasks: Step through sections and jump to a coordinate
Zoom and pan to follow a fine process
Rotate and zoom the 3-D reconstruction to see the cell's shape

features.name: Editable position bar with axis scrubber
features.general: Read the current coordinate and the coordinate under the mouse, type a new value to jump there, and copy the position
features.specific: Top bar x/y/z (8 nm) fields; the orange numbers show the mouse position; typing a z value opens a 0–8089 range scrubber with a Playback button; the copy icon copies the position
steps: hover to read the coordinate under the mouse
type a value into x, y or z and press Enter
use the axis scrubber that appears
press copy to copy the position
serves_tasks: Step through sections and jump to a coordinate

features.name: Segment set list with query, add and per-item visibility
features.general: Keep a working list of chosen objects: add them by clicking in the image or typing an ID, filter the list, hide or show each one, and see the count of visible items
features.specific: Seg. tab: 'Enter ID, name prefix or /regexp' box (Enter adds the ID), rows with star, eye and coloured ID chip, an 'N/M visible' header; double-clicking in a slice adds a segment, and its mesh appears in 3-D
steps: double-click an object in a slice, or type its ID and press Enter
watch it appear in the list and its mesh load in 3-D
press its eye to hide or show it
use the query box to filter the list
serves_tasks: Add an object to the displayed set by clicking it in a section
Add an object by typing its ID
Temporarily hide one object without dropping it from the set

features.name: Hover readout and pinned selection inspector
features.general: Show the value of every layer under the mouse; pin a point so its values stay listed in a side panel, and act on them from there
features.specific: Layer chips show the image value or segment ID on hover; control+right-click pins the position in the Selection panel (copy position, image value, segment with star and eye); the eye adds the segment to the visible set
steps: hover to read values in the layer chips
control+right-click to pin the point
read the position and values in the Selection panel
press the eye or star to act on the segment
serves_tasks: Add an object from a pinned point inspection

features.name: Label overlay rendering controls
features.general: Tune how a label map is drawn over raw data: opacity of selected and unselected labels, random or fixed colours, saturation, and outline-style 3-D shading
features.specific: Segmentation Render tab: Color seed or Fixed color, Saturation, Opacity (on/off), Opacity (3d), Silhouette (3d), Hide segment ID 0, Highlight on hover; 'l' re-randomises the colour seed
steps: open the Render tab
drag Opacity (on) to set overlay strength
switch Color seed or Fixed color, or press l to recolour
drag Silhouette (3d) for outline shading of the meshes
serves_tasks: Adjust how strongly and in what colour the labels are drawn
Recolour objects so neighbours are easier to tell apart

features.name: Intensity window with histogram and auto-range
features.general: Set the display range of a grayscale image on a histogram, with one-click percentile auto-ranges and an invert arrow
features.specific: Image Rendering tab 'normalized' invlerp control: histogram with editable window bounds and mapped range (e.g. window 57/206 and range 82→181 for the view in this run; percentile buttons recompute them from what is in view), Min-Max, 1-99% and 5-95% buttons, invert-range arrow
steps: open the Rendering tab
press 5-95% (or Min-Max or 1-99%)
fine-tune the range numbers or drag on the histogram
optionally flip it with the arrow
serves_tasks: Stretch the image contrast

features.name: Live GLSL shader editor that generates its own controls
features.general: Edit a small per-pixel display program; controls the program declares appear as widgets, and their values are saved in the view state
features.specific: Rendering-tab Shader box: '#uicontrol invlerp' and '#uicontrol bool … checkbox' lines become a histogram widget and a checkbox; the shader recompiles when the editor loses focus
steps: open the shader box
type a shader that declares a #uicontrol
click out to compile
use the generated control (e.g. tick or untick 'invert')
serves_tasks: Write a custom display formula that adds its own UI control

features.name: Layer bar and layer list with visibility and archiving
features.general: Manage stacked data layers: click to show or hide, open each layer's settings, archive layers out of the bar, add new layers
features.specific: Top layer chips (click hides, control+click opens the side panel, X and bin icons), the Layers panel with checkboxes (unticking archives the layer out of the bar, which differs from hiding), and + (right-click adds a local annotation layer)
steps: click a layer chip to hide or show it
control+click to open its side panel
open the Layers panel and untick to archive
press + or right-click + to add a layer
serves_tasks: Show or hide a whole layer to compare raw against overlay
Set a layer aside out of the working set (archive it) and bring it back
Mark a point of interest and attach a note

features.name: Spatial annotation tools with list, notes and fly-to
features.general: Place points, lines, boxes, ellipsoids or polylines on the volume, list them with coordinates, attach notes and linked object IDs, and jump back to any of them
features.specific: Annotation layer Annotations tab: tool buttons ⚬ ❑ ꕹ ◎ ⤤ (control+click places), a coordinate list with Prev/Next, Selection panel with Description and related 'segments', delete and move-to; right-click a row recentres the view
steps: add a local annotation layer
pick a tool (point or line)
control+click in a slice to place it
type a Description in the Selection panel
right-click the row later to jump back
serves_tasks: Mark a point of interest and attach a note
Draw a measuring line across a structure
Return to a marked location

features.name: Whole-view state as editable JSON / URL
features.general: Keep the entire view (data sources, position, selections, styling, annotations) as one JSON document you can edit, apply, download or share as a link
features.specific: {} Edit JSON state dialog (foldable tree, Apply changes, Download state.json); the URL fragment is kept in sync; Copy URL to clipboard
steps: open the {} editor
edit a field (e.g. layout)
press Apply changes
press Download or Copy URL to share
serves_tasks: Edit the full view description directly

features.name: Scaled screenshot export with physical-scale report
features.general: Export the current view as an image at 1×, 2× or 4× resolution, with a preview of output size and the physical size of each pixel per panel

choose a scale factor
review the size and nm/px table
press Take screenshot (or Force screenshot)
serves_tasks: Export a high-resolution figure

features.name: Layer data-source and coordinate-transform panel

features.specific: Layer side panel Source tab (control+click a layer chip): data type (uint8 / uint64), subsources such as [bounds] and [mesh], per-axis 8 nm scale, bounds, identity transform matrix

read the data type and subsources

read the transform matrix
